A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work and contain readable main text, figures, tables, equations, and Appendices A-K. Bibliography compression shifts appendix pagination without removing scientific material.

before.justification: v1 reports original model-training experiments, perplexity and few-shot evaluations, ablations, timing measurements, and throughput simulations in Section 3 and Appendices D-K.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results and simulations, including the detailed appendix tables.

M1.justification: CYCLE layer tying, the three initialization strategies, SVD-initialized layer-wise LoRA, training losses, and continuous depth-wise batching are unchanged. Appendix H's newly mentioned bias-based relaxation is future work, not an implemented component.

E1.justification: Both versions use SlimPajama for uptraining, SlimPajama/RedPajama/PG19 for language-model evaluation and throughput simulations, and the same seven few-shot benchmarks. No evaluated task, dataset, or deployment scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain the same full-size, reduced-size, initialization, and distillation comparisons, plus vanilla throughput baselines with and without continuous sequence-wise batching. Newly cited approaches are not added as evaluated baselines.

E3.justification: Table F.1 changes the full-size TinyLlama baseline's uptraining-token entry from 15B to a dash, aligning it with the original-checkpoint baseline already specified in Section 3.2 and Table 2. This corrects a reported setting; it does not establish that experiments were rerun. Other protocols remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The initialization, normalization, LoRA-rank, prefix-tuning, distillation, early-exit, and throughput-scenario analyses are retained. The additions in Appendices B, F, and H provide discussion and citations without new ablations or robustness evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions retain the same point estimates and averaging practices. Neither reports seed or repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Original perplexity, accuracy, timing, and throughput results remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table F.1 retains the TinyLlama baseline's 43.3% average accuracy; its changed entry concerns training metadata. Appendix B's added CYCLE comparison is attributed to prior work.

T1.justification: Equations (1)-(5), Appendix A's architectural definitions, SVD reasoning, and the oracle-throughput assumptions are unchanged. The added hardware discussion introduces no mathematical definition, derivation, theorem, or proof.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same compression, performance-recovery, and hypothetical 2-3x throughput claims. The principal novelty claims are not revised.

C2.justification: Appendix B newly explains SEQUENCE's potential SRAM/DRAM weight-transfer advantage and why compatibility with early exiting motivates choosing CYCLE. Appendix H adds bias-term relaxation as a future direction. Existing prefix-tuning limitations and hypothetical-throughput caveats remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Table F.1 corrects the TinyLlama baseline's training-budget documentation. The Gao et al. evaluation-framework reference also loses its explicit Zenodo access link. Appendix E's implementation, optimizer, hardware, and data-processing details remain unchanged.

R1.justification: Seven cited works are added, covering additional parameter-sharing, normalization, and adapter approaches. Appendix H now explicitly acknowledges Ge et al. (2022) and Shim et al. (2024) as related precedents for relaxing parameter sharing; Section 4 and Appendices B and F also gain contextual citations. The overall positioning remains intact.

P1.justification: Limited passages in Section 4 and Appendices B, F, and H are rewritten or expanded, and Appendix H receives a broader title. Bibliographic entries are shortened and date information is updated. The main narrative and section order are preserved.

P2.justification: Expanded prose shifts Figure B.1 and Table H.1 slightly within their pages, while shortened bibliography entries change reference-page layout. Figures and tables retain their designs, captions, axes, and legends; no scientific display is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 corrects the inconsistent TinyLlama training-budget label, improves attribution to related approaches, and explains the layer-sharing design tradeoff more clearly. These modest gains in consistency and context outweigh the small access-documentation loss from removing the evaluation-framework link. The methods, empirical evidence, and limitations of hypothetical throughput estimates remain unchanged.
